links.explanation: Both reports highlight the absence of clear guidance or protocols for managing acute sickle cell crises, which puts patients at risk. The earlier report focuses on a regional protocol gap in the West Midlands, while the later report notes that local improvements have not been shared nationwide.
links.earlier_quote: Evidence at the inquest confirmed that there needed to be a clear protocol in the West Midlands for the management of patients with Sickle cell disease.
links.later_quote: I am not at all clear that this work has been replicated nationally.
